title: Delta Lake: ACID, Time Travel, OPTIMIZE

scenes.line1: How reliable is your data lake?
scenes.say: Ever wondered if your data lake can guarantee consistency and let you see past data versions?

scenes.label: ACID
scenes.sub: Delta Lake uses transactions for reliable updates.
scenes.say: Delta Lake brings atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability—so updates and deletes are always reliable.

scenes.title: Query old table versions
scenes.say: Time travel lets you query historical table versions. Great for auditing or debugging changes.
Use OPTIMIZE to compact files. Z-order arranges data for faster filtering on multiple columns.

scenes.question: Why does Delta Lake enable time travel?
scenes.right: To audit, debug, and recover old data versions
scenes.say: Don’t confuse time travel with just performance. It’s key for auditing, debugging, and recovering old data.
